title: Fantastic tour + tour guide in Barcelona! Highly recommend!
text: Joan was our tour guide and driver for our day in Barcelona - he was absolutely AMAZING! Our family of 6 truly enjoyed his commentary about all of the sights in Barcelona, such as the history with the Olympics, the Sagrada Familia, and other various monuments around the city. Not only was he extremely knowledgable, he was very accommodating to our needs (we traveled with grandparents, so more accessible stops/pick up points were needed). He asked us what areas we wanted to go to, what our interests were, and took us to so many spots in the time we had before we needed to go back to the airport
author: Kelli_L
